info.title: ETMS Gate-Scanning API (INDIA DAY 2026)
info.description:
REST API consumed by the ETMS Flutter gate-scanning app. All timestamps are UTC ISO 8601 (`...Z`).

**Authentication**: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` returns a 15-minute JWT access token and a rotating refresh token. Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.
Roles: `Administrator` (ETMS SuperAdmin/Admin) and `GateScanner`. Gate scanners may list/search tickets (contact data masked), scan and view their own scan history.

**Pagination**: `page` (1-based) and `pageSize` (default 50, max 100). Every list returns `pagination { page, pageSize, totalRecords, totalPages, hasNextPage, hasPreviousPage }`.

**Errors**: RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` with `code` and `correlationId` (also in the `X-Correlation-ID` response header).
Validation errors are `400` with an `errors` map. `401` missing/invalid token, `403` insufficient role, `404` not found, `409` conflict / invalid status transition / duplicate clientScanId,
`422` semantically invalid (unknown gate, device mismatch), `429` rate limited (`Retry-After`), `503` database temporarily unavailable.

**Scan result codes** (`POST /api/v1/ticket-scans`, HTTP 200 for every processed outcome, 409 for `DuplicateRequest`, 503 for `TemporarilyUnavailable`):
`Valid` (admission granted), `AlreadyUsed`, `Invalid`, `Cancelled`, `Replaced`, `NotPaid`, `NotIssued`, `WrongEvent`, `Expired`, `UnauthorizedGate`, `DuplicateRequest`, `TemporarilyUnavailable`.
Exactly one of several simultaneous scans of the same ticket receives `Valid`; the others receive `AlreadyUsed`. Retrying with the same `clientScanId` replays the original result (`replayed: true`).

post.summary: Sign in with ETMS credentials and obtain a short-lived access token plus a rotating refresh token.
post.description:
Accounts must be active, not locked, not flagged for a forced password change, and hold the SuperAdmin, Admin or GateScanner role.
Tokens are bound to `deviceId`. Store both tokens in platform secure storage (Keychain / Keystore), never in shared preferences.
Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per IP address. Account lockout after 5 failed attempts (15 minutes, same policy as the web application).

**Authentication:** none (anonymous, rate limited per IP).

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new access token and a NEW refresh token (rotation).
post.description:
The presented refresh token is consumed. Presenting a consumed or revoked token again is treated as theft: the whole token family is revoked
and the app must sign in again (`code`: RefreshTokenReused). The `deviceId` must match the one used at login.

**Authentication:** none (anonymous, rate limited per IP).

post.summary: Sign out: revokes the refresh token (and its rotation family) and denies the current access token immediately.
post.description:
Without a body the refresh tokens of the calling device are revoked. `allDevices: true` terminates every session of the user.

**Requires:** Bearer token; role any authenticated user.

get.summary: Download the individual Corporate Dinner passes of the active event (paged, incremental): pass id and number, attendee name, batch, status and entry state with the original entry time.
get.description:
First call without `cursor`; keep calling while `hasMore`; store `nextCursor` after the run and pass it next time to receive only
passes changed since (new, used, cancelled). Items are upserts keyed by `passId` / `passNumber`. The QR secret is never included:
the pass QR is an encrypted token that only the server can verify.

**Requires:** `X-Device-Token` of a provisioned scanner device (scope: DinnerPass). No operator login.

post.summary: Scan Corporate Dinner Pass: verify the `CDP1.` pass QR and record the first entry atomically (pass Issued → Used, server UTC time).
post.description:
Every later scan of the same pass returns `AlreadyUsed` with the original entry time (`firstEntryAtUtc`, `firstEntryLocal`) and never
changes it; two devices scanning concurrently get exactly one `Valid`. Retrying with the same `clientScanId` replays the stored result
(`replayed: true`). A ticket QR is `WrongCredentialType`; a cancelled pass is `Cancelled`; an unknown or tampered QR is `Invalid`.
409 = `DuplicateRequest` (same id, different payload), 503 = `TemporarilyUnavailable` (nothing recorded - retry with the same id).

**Requires:** `X-Device-Token` of a provisioned scanner device (scope: DinnerPass). No operator login.

post.summary: Scan Ticket Entry: verify an INDIA DAY 2026 ticket QR and record the regular admission (Issued → Used) atomically.
post.description:
Every processed outcome is HTTP 200 with a stable `result`. `AlreadyUsed` carries the original entry time (`firstEntryAtUtc`,
`firstEntryLocal`) and never changes it. A dinner pass QR is `WrongCredentialType`. Retrying with the same `clientScanId` replays the
original result (`replayed: true`). 409 = `DuplicateRequest`, 503 = `TemporarilyUnavailable` (nothing changed - retry with the same id).

**Requires:** `X-Device-Token` of a provisioned scanner device (scope: Ticket). No operator login.

post.summary: Scan Gen Z Access: verify the SAME ticket QR and record the Gen-Z Dancing Area entry, independently of the regular entry.
post.description:
Requires a paid, active Gen-Z entitlement on the ticket (`NotEligible` otherwise). `BeforeStartTime` before `GenZ.AccessStartTime`
(event local time). With re-entry allowed by the organisers (setting `GenZ.SingleEntry` = false) a later scan is still `AlreadyUsed` with the
first entry time but `reEntryAllowed: true`. Regular ticket entry is NOT required first unless the server is configured so (`EntryRequired`).

**Requires:** `X-Device-Token` of a provisioned scanner device (scope: GenZ). No operator login.

post.summary: Upload scans captured while offline (any mix of the three types). Each item gets its own final result; the batch itself always succeeds.
post.description:
Items are processed in order through exactly the same logic as the live endpoints, so a retried batch replays the stored results. `accepted` = false
only for `TemporarilyUnavailable` (keep the item and resend). `conflict` = true when the app had shown `offlineDecision: Admitted` but the
server's authoritative outcome is different - typically `AlreadyUsed` because another device admitted the credential first; show the operator
the server result and the original entry time. Offline screens must say "pending confirmation", never "admitted", until the item is accepted as Valid.

**Requires:** `X-Device-Token` of a provisioned scanner device (scope: any). No operator login.

patch.summary: Administrator-controlled status change with optimistic concurrency and a mandatory reason.
patch.description:
Whitelisted transitions: Pending/Approved/Issued → `Cancelled`; Issued → `Expired`; Expired → `Issued` (reinstate).
`Used` can never be set here (scan endpoint only); Cancelled/Replaced tickets cannot be changed. A stale `rowVersion` yields 409.
Records old status, new status, administrator, reason and timestamp in TicketStatusHistory and AuditLogs.

**Requires:** Bearer token; role Administrator (SuperAdmin, Admin).

post.summary: Validate a scanned QR payload and, when valid, atomically mark the ticket as used.
post.description:
Server-side steps: authenticate/authorise the officer → validate the request → verify QR structure, version and HMAC signature →
find the ticket → confirm INDIA DAY 2026 → confirm payment (paid tickets) → confirm Issued → reject cancelled/replaced/expired/not issued →
detect already used → atomically Issued→Used under a row lock → record server entry time, gate, officer, device and clientScanId →
write status history and audit → return the result.
            
**HTTP status behaviour:** every processed outcome (Valid, AlreadyUsed, Cancelled, Replaced, NotPaid, NotIssued, WrongEvent, Expired,
UnauthorizedGate, Invalid) is HTTP **200** with a stable `result` code so the app handles them uniformly. **409** = `DuplicateRequest`
(same clientScanId, different payload). **422** = unknown gate or device mismatch (problem body). **503** = `TemporarilyUnavailable` (nothing changed - retry with the same clientScanId).
            
**Idempotency:** the same `clientScanId` always returns the original result (`replayed: true`) without creating another scan record.
The device clock (`scannedAtUtc`) is stored for diagnostics only; the official entry time is the database clock.

**Requires:** Bearer token; role GateScanner or Administrator (GateScanner, Admin, SuperAdmin).

post.summary: Batch reconciliation of scans captured while offline (disabled unless `Scanning:OfflineSyncEnabled` is true).
post.description:
Each item is validated against the authoritative database state exactly like a live scan and reported individually; tickets already admitted
on another device come back as `AlreadyUsed`. **Risk (documented):** admitting offline means the same ticket may have entered at another
gate - offline mode must be an explicit business decision. Default: HTTP 501.

**Requires:** Bearer token; role GateScanner or Administrator (GateScanner, Admin, SuperAdmin).

What the app showed the operator while offline: `Admitted` (provisional green), `Rejected`, or null for a live scan.
Used by `/scanner/sync` to flag a conflict when the server's authoritative outcome differs.

ScannerScanRequest.description: Body of the three scan endpoints. No gate, no operator, no device id: the device is the credential in the `X-Device-Token` header.

scanType.description: The three actions of the scanner app.

result.description: Stable outcome of a scanner-app scan. Every processed outcome is HTTP 200; the app renders one of three screens from `admissionGranted` / `result`.

admissionGranted.description: True only when THIS request (or the original request this one replays) recorded the first admission.

replayed.description: True when the response replays the stored outcome of an earlier request with the same clientScanId.

message.description: Operator-facing text, e.g. "Entry granted." or "Already scanned at 7:14 PM".

firstEntryAtUtc.description: Server UTC time of the FIRST admission of this credential (set for Valid and AlreadyUsed). Never changes afterwards.

firstEntryLocal.description: The same instant in event local time, ready to display ("7:14 PM").

reEntryAllowed.description: Gen-Z only: the organisers allow re-entry, so an `AlreadyUsed` guest may pass again (the first entry time still stands).

accessStartTime.description: Gen-Z only: local "HH:mm" the area opens (also returned with BeforeStartTime).

processedAtUtc.description: Server time the scan was processed.

qrPayload.description: Complete text decoded from the QR code (ticket: `ETMS.…`; dinner pass: `CDP1.…`).

clientScanId.description: UUID generated by the app for this physical scan and persisted until a final result is stored. Retrying with the same id replays the original result.

scannedAtUtc.description: Device clock at scan time - diagnostic only; the server clock is the entry time.

offlineDecision.description:
What the app showed the operator while offline: `Admitted` (provisional green), `Rejected`, or null for a live scan.
Used by `/scanner/sync` to flag a conflict when the server's authoritative outcome differs.

scanType.description: The three actions of the scanner app.

ScannerSyncItem.description: One offline-captured scan inside a sync batch.

scanType.description: The three actions of the scanner app.

accepted.description: True when the server processed the item and stored a final outcome (any result but TemporarilyUnavailable). False = keep it queued and resend.

conflict.description: True when the app had shown "Admitted" offline but the server's authoritative outcome is different (usually AlreadyUsed: another device admitted the same credential first). Show the operator the server result.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `?cursor=` on the next call. Store it once every page of a run has been applied.

hasMore.description: True when more records are waiting: call again immediately with `nextCursor`.

ScannerSyncPageOfScannerDinnerPassRecord.description: Incremental download page. Items are upserts keyed by ticketId / passNumber; a record may appear again when it changed.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `?cursor=` on the next call. Store it once every page of a run has been applied.

hasMore.description: True when more records are waiting: call again immediately with `nextCursor`.

ScannerSyncPageOfScannerTicketRecord.description: Incremental download page. Items are upserts keyed by ticketId / passNumber; a record may appear again when it changed.

ticketId.description: Public ticket reference. Equals the secure id inside the ticket QR body, so the app can match a scanned code offline (the signature can NOT be checked offline).

status.description: Pending, Approved, Issued, Used, Cancelled, Replaced, Rejected, Expired.

eligibleForEntry.description: Server view of "would be admitted now" (Issued and, for paid tickets, fully paid). Provisional for offline display only.

genZEntitled.description: True when a paid, active Gen-Z entitlement exists for this ticket.

genZStatus.description: NotIncluded, PendingPayment, Active, Cancelled, Refunded, Used.

ScannerTicketRecord.description: One ticket as the scanner app needs it. No contact data, no QR payload.

ticketId.description: Secure public ticket reference (random 128-bit GUID, never the database id).

scannedDateUtc.description: Entry time recorded by the server (null until admitted).

tableNumber.description:
Table the attendee is seated at, for table-booked categories (VVIP Platinum, VVIP, VIP, Deluxe) and sponsor table allocations;
null for quantity categories (Executive Dignitaries, Gold, Silver, child categories). Added 2026-09-27.

bookingQuantity.description: Number of tickets in the same booking.

genZAccess.description: True only while the attendee's Gen-Z entitlement is paid and active.

genZStatus.description: NotSelected | PendingPayment | Active | Cancelled | Refunded | Used.

genZAccessStartTime.description: Local (event time) "HH:mm" the Gen-Z area opens; present only when the attendee holds the add-on.

qrPayload.description: Complete text decoded from the QR code (ETMS.<payload>.<signature>).

deviceId.description: Must equal the device the access token was issued to.

clientScanId.description: UUID generated by the app for this physical scan. Re-sending the same id returns the original result (idempotent retry).

scannedAtUtc.description: Device clock at scan time - diagnostic only, never used as the entry time.

TicketScanRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/ticket-scans`. The scanning officer is the authenticated user - never sent in the body.

replayed.description: True when this response replays the result of an earlier request with the same clientScanId.

processedAtUtc.description: Server time the scan was processed.

status.description: Target status. Allowed: `Cancelled` (from Pending/Approved/Issued), `Expired` (from Issued), `Issued` (from Expired). Never `Used`.

UpdateTicketStatusRequest.description: Administrator-controlled status change. Gate scanners must use `POST /ticket-scans`.

Bearer.description: Short-lived access token from POST /api/v1/auth/login. Send as: Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}

DeviceToken.description: Scanner app (no login): the provisioned device token from POST /api/v1/scanner/enrol. Send as: X-Device-Token: {deviceToken}

tags.name: Auth

tags.name: CorporateDinnerPasses
tags.description:
Corporate Dinner passes for the scanner app (no login). Same implementation as `/scanner/dinner-passes` and
`/scanner/dinner-passes/scan`, exposed under the resource route the Flutter app uses. Authentication: header `X-Device-Token`
(provisioned device credential) - the device is identified by that credential; no operator, gate or device id travels in the body.

tags.name: ReferenceData
tags.description: Reference data of the active event.

tags.name: Scanner
tags.description:
Scanner app without login (2026-09-28). Authentication: header `X-Device-Token` (provisioned device credential, see
`POST /scanner/enrol`). No gate, no operator and no device id travel in requests or responses.

tags.name: ScannerDevices
